caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, light-colored background. The object appears to be an old-fashioned metal door knocker, consisting of a flat, shield-shaped backplate with a rough texture and carved patterns. Attached to the backplate is a circular ring, decorated with engraved lines, which is mounted at the top by a rectangular clasp. In the center of the ring, there is a raised circular boss adorned with a small, detailed rosette or flower design. The overall color scheme of the drawing is grayscale, with various shades of gray used to convey the metallic appearance and shadows of the object. The artist's name, Joseph Stonefield, is written in small letters in the lower left corner of the drawing.
title: Door Knocker
